verdict.rationale: Railway's docs say you can develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the official CLI, which suggests local files can be deployed without connecting a repo. The evidence never says no Git repo is required, and nothing shows deployments stay private until published; railway-docs-4 instead describes public endpoints live from the moment you deploy. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of Git-free folder upload, a private-until-publish deployment mode, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
